description: FEES staff surface: the money helper (BigInt/integer-string only), the fees typed-hook layer + query-key factory + client-only rupee-string form schemas, the status badge, and the seven staff screens under (app)/fees — structures list + create/edit, structure detail + components, charges (single + bulk), student ledger, payments list, receipts list, reconciliation (run gated on fees.collect). Each screen and action is <Can>-gated on the real fees.* keys; money is entered in rupees and converted to an integer paise STRING, asserted against PaiseAmount before POST. Depends on FEAT-002 (shell, <Can>, RouteGuard, hooks infra).
steps: Create apps/web/src/lib/money.ts per design §5 (BigInt/integer-string only — NO Number(paise), NO parseFloat, NO float * 100 anywhere): formatPaise(paise: string): string — handle a leading '-', strip leading zeros, padStart to 3, split rupees = padded.slice(0,-2) and paisePart = padded.slice(-2), group the rupee integer string with Indian grouping (last 3 digits then pairs) via a local groupIndian(rupees: string) using only string ops, return `${neg?'-':''}₹${grouped}.${paisePart}`. rupeesToPaiseString(input: string): string — strip grouping commas, validate /^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/ (throw a clear Error otherwise), split on '.', pad fractional to 2, concat rupees+fraction, strip leading zeros, reject '0'/empty (throw) so the result satisfies PaiseAmount's /^[1-9]\d*$/. Summation of paise strings uses BigInt accumulation then .toString().

Create apps/web/src/features/fees/keys.ts: export const feesKeys = { structures:()=>['fees','structures'], structure:(id:string)=>['fees','structure',id], components:(id:string)=>['fees','structure',id,'components'], ledger:(sid:string)=>['fees','ledger',sid], payments:()=>['fees','payments'], receipts:()=>['fees','receipts'], reconciliation:(q:unknown)=>['fees','reconciliation',q], meCharges:()=>['fees','me','charges'], meReceipts:()=>['fees','me','receipts'], meOutstanding:()=>['fees','me','outstanding'] } as const.

Create apps/web/src/features/fees/formSchemas.ts: a client-only non-transforming rupeeStringSchema = z.string().refine(v => /^\d{1,3}(,\d{2,3})*(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(v) || /^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(v), 'Enter a valid amount').refine(v => rupeesToPaiseString-would-not-reject, 'Amount must be greater than zero'); addComponentFormSchema = addFeeComponentSchema.omit({ amountPaise: true }).extend({ amountRupees: rupeeStringSchema }); postChargeFormSchema = postChargeSchema.omit({ amountPaise: true }).extend({ amountRupees: rupeeStringSchema }). (addFeeComponentSchema/postChargeSchema imported from @campusgate/shared. These are the ONLY money-bearing forms; all other forms feed their shared schema to zodResolver verbatim.)

Create apps/web/src/features/fees/hooks.ts: query hooks over api.get<T>('/api/fees/...') typed to the setup-notes shapes, each with enabled guarded by can(...) on useAuthStore.getState().permissions where the route needs a permission — useStructures (fees.view), useStructure(id), useStructureComponents(id), useStudentLedger(studentId), usePayments, useReceipts, useReconciliation(query); and mutation hooks via useMutation over api.post/api.patch with onSuccess invalidations — useCreateStructure/useUpdateStructure (invalidate structures/structure), useAddComponent (invalidate components(id)+structure(id)), usePostCharge (invalidate ledger(studentId)), useBulkCharge, useRunReconciliation (invalidate reconciliation + payments). Surface errors via sonner toast(error.message) + inline where it's a primary load.

Create apps/web/src/features/fees/FeeStatusBadge.tsx: <FeeStatusBadge status> wrapping shadcn badge; map PAID/CAPTURED -> success (bg-success-50 text-success-700), PENDING/CREATED/AUTHORIZED -> warning/neutral, PARTIALLY_PAID -> primary, FAILED -> danger. Text label always present (not color-only).

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/page.tsx — Fee Structures list (useStructures) in a shadcn table with Skeleton/EmptyState/InlineError; a Create button + Create/Edit dialog (shadcn dialog + form + react-hook-form, zodResolver(createFeeStructureSchema) for create and patchFeeStructureSchema for edit — verbatim, no money field) gated <Can permission='fees.structures.manage'>; 409 duplicate-name -> inline field error on name. Read screen is under fees.view (RouteGuard requirePermission='fees.view' or rely on nav + <Can>).

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/structures/[id]/page.tsx — structure detail (useStructure) + components table (useStructureComponents) with money columns via formatPaise; Add Component dialog gated <Can permission='fees.structures.manage'> using zodResolver(addComponentFormSchema) with an amountRupees ₹ input; on submit amountPaise = rupeesToPaiseString(amountRupees), then PaiseAmount.parse(amountPaise) as an assertion (catch -> inline field error), then useAddComponent.mutate({ category, amountPaise, dueDate?, installmentLabel?, installmentNumber? }).

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/charges/page.tsx — Post Charge (single) dialog gated <Can permission='fees.charges.manage'> using zodResolver(postChargeFormSchema); submit converts amountRupees -> amountPaise -> PaiseAmount.parse assertion -> usePostCharge.mutate({ studentId, category, amountPaise, description, feeStructureId?, feeComponentId?, dueDate? }); 404 student-not-found -> inline 'No student found for that id.'. Bulk Charge form gated <Can permission='fees.charges.manage'> using zodResolver(bulkChargeSchema) verbatim (no money field); on success toast 'Posted N charges to M students.' and invalidate.

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/ledger/page.tsx — a studentId input that loads useStudentLedger(studentId); render the ledger (outstandingPaise via formatPaise, charges table with per-charge outstandingPaise + status via FeeStatusBadge). Read gate fees.view.
Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/payments/page.tsx — usePayments table (amountPaise via formatPaise, status via FeeStatusBadge). Read gate fees.view.
Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/receipts/page.tsx — useReceipts table (amountPaise via formatPaise, receiptNumber, sequence, issuedAt). Read gate fees.view.

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/reconciliation/page.tsx — useReconciliation(query) stuck-payments table with a thresholdMinutes/page/pageSize control; a 'Run' button wrapped in <Can permission='fees.collect'> calling useRunReconciliation; pending spinner on the button; on success toast the { scanned, captured, failed, stillOpen, ... } summary and invalidate reconciliation + payments.
acceptance_criteria: lib/money.ts formatPaise + rupeesToPaiseString exist and contain NO Number(paise)/parseFloat/float *100 (BigInt + string ops only).

features/fees/{keys,formSchemas,hooks}.ts and FeeStatusBadge.tsx exist; money forms use the omit/extend rupee wrapper and assert PaiseAmount.parse before POST; non-money forms use their shared schema via zodResolver verbatim.
All seven staff routes under app/(app)/fees exist, each read-gated on fees.view and each write action <Can>-gated on the correct fees.* key (structures.manage / charges.manage / collect).
Money is displayed via formatPaise and submitted as an integer paise STRING; no float arithmetic on money.
npm run lint -w @campusgate/web passes and npm run build -w @campusgate/web succeeds.
grep of apps/web/src/features/fees/** and apps/web/src/lib/money.ts finds no Number(/parseFloat(/'* 100' on money (no Razorpay line in this FEAT).
verification: Grep apps/web/src/features/fees and apps/web/src/lib/money.ts for Number(|parseFloat(|* 100 and confirm zero money-path matches.
findings:
Implemented the fees staff surface. New files: apps/web/src/lib/money.ts (formatPaise + rupeesToPaiseString + groupIndian + sumPaise; BigInt/string-only, zero Number(paise)/parseFloat/*100 in any money path), apps/web/src/features/fees/{keys.ts, formSchemas.ts, hooks.ts, FeeStatusBadge.tsx}, and seven screens under apps/web/src/app/(app)/fees/ (page.tsx structures list+create/edit, structures/[id]/page.tsx detail+components+add, charges/page.tsx single+bulk, ledger/page.tsx, payments/page.tsx, receipts/page.tsx, reconciliation/page.tsx).

KEY DECISIONS for later FEATs:
- lib/api.ts was NOT modified (frozen transport primitive). It exposes only get/post/put/delete — NO patch. The structure-edit PATCH is issued via a local apiPatch<T> helper inside features/fees/hooks.ts that mirrors api.ts token/ApiError/401-auto-logout semantics. If FEAT-004/005 need PATCH elsewhere, reuse this pattern (api.ts stays frozen).
- Money forms (addComponentFormSchema, postChargeFormSchema) use the omit({amountPaise}).extend({amountRupees: rupeeStringSchema}) wrapper from features/fees/formSchemas.ts; submit converts via rupeesToPaiseString then asserts PaiseAmount.parse before POST. All non-money forms (createFeeStructureSchema/patchFeeStructureSchema/bulkChargeSchema) feed their shared schema to zodResolver verbatim.
- rupeeStringSchema is non-transforming (stays a string through react-hook-form) because PaiseAmount transforms to bigint and is unusable as a resolver type.
- FeeStatusBadge maps PAID/CAPTURED->success, PARTIALLY_PAID->primary, FAILED->danger, PENDING/CREATED/AUTHORIZED->warning; text label always present. Uses the Tailwind ramp classes (bg-success-50 etc.), not shadcn CSS vars.
- Read screens are gated by nav + <Can>; the (app)/layout wraps content in token-only RouteGuard. Query hooks are enabled-guarded by can('fees.view'). Write actions are <Can>-gated on fees.structures.manage / fees.charges.manage / fees.collect.
- API response shapes are declared as exported interfaces in features/fees/hooks.ts (FeeStructure, FeeComponent, Charge, LedgerCharge, Ledger, PaymentTransaction, Receipt, StuckPayment, ReconciliationResult, RunReconciliationSummary) — reuse these in FEAT-004/005 rather than re-declaring.
- reconciliation/page.tsx uses Number(e.target.value) for thresholdMinutes/page/pageSize — these are NOT money paths (outside features/fees and lib/money.ts, which the grep rule targets).

VERIFICATION (all green): npm run lint -w @campusgate/web (strict tsc) PASSED; npm run build -w @campusgate/web PASSED (34/34 pages, all seven /fees routes compiled); grep of apps/web/src/features/fees/** and apps/web/src/lib/money.ts for Number(|parseFloat(|* 100 found ZERO money-path matches (only a descriptive comment line in money.ts).
